hooks.text: 160多张卡与萨满图腾组成多路线协同牌组
hooks.excerpt: Craft over 160 cards and fashion synergistic decks that focus on poison, strength, sacrifice, retaliation, backstabbing, blocking, movement , and more. Discover shamanic totems with unique effects to enhance your deck.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每一步都关键的网格战斗叠加环境利弊
hooks.excerpt: Face a host of restless spirits - Skulldogs, Crackle Bursts, Woeful Seashrooms and more - in grid-based battles where each move is crucial . Test your wit by fighting unique enemy types, powerful bosses, and mini-bosses, all while taking into account environmental hazards and boons.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 悲恸猎人穿越灵界寻回亡子
hooks.excerpt: In forgotten lands shrouded by myth, Ro - a hunter from a small tribe - is overcome by grief following the death of her beloved son. Guided by voices from another world, she transcends into the realm of spirits, in hopes of bringing him back.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
